excerpt.zh:
看起来对方抢了我们的风头，在我们尚未解密他们的通讯模式前和我们建立了接触。

在下次有这样的机会出现时，希望可以由我们来完成这一步吧。
excerpt.en:
It appears the other party completely stole our thunder, establishing contact with us before we had managed to decipher their communications protocols.

We should still attempt to accomplish this feat for ourselves, when the opportunity next presents itself.
